articles.title: Undo History panel
articles.summary: Undo History lists your recent actions so you can step back through them, redo them, or clear the list.
articles.what: Open it from the toolbar HISTORY menu, or from Zones > More. The panel has Undo (Ctrl+Z), Redo (Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z) and Clear. Clear wipes the whole history and cannot be undone. Every change the AI copilot makes counts as one undo step for the zones it changed, so its Undo button takes all of that answer back at once.
when: You want to go back more than one step.
You tried several looks and want to return to an earlier one.
how: 1. Open HISTORY in the toolbar and choose Undo History.
2. Press Undo to step back and Redo to step forward.
3. Close the panel when you are done.
tips: Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y work without opening the panel.
pitfalls: Clear removes all history. You cannot undo that.

deep.heading: What the list shows
deep.body: The panel is titled UNDO HISTORY and shows a count such as 3 actions. The top row is Current State, then your recent steps newest first, each tagged by type: Zone, Zone mask, Pixels, Layer or Decal, with how long ago it happened. The list shows the latest 50 steps. Rows are for reading: you step back with Undo, in the exact order things happened.

deep.heading: One Undo button, many kinds of step
deep.body: Undo and Redo follow the order you actually worked in, whether the last step was a zone change, a selection, painting on pixels or a Layer action. A fresh zone edit is never overruled by older paint strokes. Redo is Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z.

deep.heading: How far back you can go
deep.body: Each kind of step keeps a different amount, because pixel snapshots are big. Selection steps keep the last 60, Layer steps 30, zone property changes 15 and painted pixel strokes only 6. If a long session stops undoing, you have gone past the limit for that kind of step, so save a project before big changes.

deep.heading: Clear really clears everything
deep.body: Clear asks you to confirm, then empties every stack: zone, selection, pixel and Layer steps, and the redo steps too. Nothing is touched on the car, but you lose the ability to go back, and the panel goes back to No history yet.

examples.title: Step back through a bad hour
examples.goal: Undo several steps and check what each one was

settings.History: open it in the toolbar, then choose Undo History
settings.Undo: press three times and read the count
settings.Redo: press once if you went too far

examples.result: The car returns to three steps ago, then one step forward. The Current State row stays at the top of the list.

examples.title: Undo a whole AI answer in one go
examples.goal: Take back everything the AI copilot just did

settings.AI copilot panel: press its Undo button on that answer

examples.result: All the zones the answer changed return to how they were, as one step.

examples.title: Start a clean slate before a risky stretch
examples.goal: Free the undo memory after a long session
examples.result: All history is emptied and the count returns to 0. Save a project first if you may want to go back.

combos.why: Full detail on Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y and what each kind of step restores.
History has limits and Clear is final, so a saved project is the lasting restore point.
The panel can also be opened from Zones > More.
Every AI answer is one undoable step, which is why it is safe to try things.

faq.q: Can I click a row to jump back to it?
faq.a: In the normal list, no. Rows are for reading, and Undo steps back in exact order. Use Undo as many times as you need.

faq.q: What are the keys for Undo and Redo?
faq.a: Ctrl+Z undoes. Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes.

faq.q: How many steps can I undo?
faq.a: It depends on the step type: 60 for selections, 30 for Layer steps, 15 for zone property changes and 6 for painted pixel strokes. The panel lists the latest 50.
No. It only empties the list of steps you can go back through, after a confirmation.
No. Clear cannot be undone, which is why it asks first.

faq.q: Why does the panel say No history yet?
faq.a: Nothing has been changed since you opened the paint, or you just pressed Clear.

mistakes.symptom: Undo stops going back after a long painting session
mistakes.cause: Painted pixel strokes keep only the last 6 steps
mistakes.fix: Save a project before heavy painting, and prefer zones and Layers where you can, which keep more steps.

mistakes.cause: Clear was pressed and confirmed, which empties every kind of step
mistakes.fix: It cannot be recovered. Open a saved project if you have one, and save one before big changes next time.

mistakes.symptom: You looked for a row to click and nothing happens
mistakes.cause: The history rows are a read-out, not buttons
mistakes.fix: Use the Undo and Redo buttons or Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y to move through steps.

protips: The Undo, Redo and Clear buttons in the panel do the same as the keys, so you can keep the panel open as a live read-out while you work.
Each type of step is labelled (Zone, Zone mask, Pixels, Layer, Decal), which tells you at a glance what your last actions were.
Clear also empties the redo steps, so do not press it if you still want to step forward again.
